Discussed how festivals vary across Indian regions.
Kavya described Diwali decorations and gujiya at home.
They identified that Diwali celebrations may include diyas in one place and phuljhadis in Mumbai.
They named Pongal and considered Bihu when recalling harvest festivals.
The comparison of how the same festival is celebrated differently was not completed.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised noticing that festivals can be celebrated differently in different places. They shared examples of making gujiya and decorating with many diyas, and identified Pongal and Bihu while discussing harvest festivals. The idea that the same festival can have different customs was not yet clearly explained; at home, compare one festival’s food, decorations, or activities in two regions using pictures or a short family discussion.
